findings.consumption_boundary: The first identified subprocess path precedes the one-shot start marker; subsequent metadata checks also occur after the start marker.
findings.evidence: Readiness installs the audit hook before verify_freeze_identity; the guard rejects non-path open arguments; subprocess.check_output creates pipes using integer file descriptors.
findings.proposed_correction: Permit only explicitly validated integer pipe descriptors associated with the existing bounded metadata subprocess operations. Require an os.fstat-based FIFO check and a scoped subprocess provenance control. Retain default-deny handling for all other descriptors and paths.
findings.risk: Required Git metadata subprocess operations may fail because opening a pipe descriptor is rejected.

findings.evidence: The positive synthetic fixture supplies representations=None; attest_ze0 requires field presence but does not validate representation contents.
findings.proposed_correction: Specify bounded synthetic positive and negative attestation cases for frozen artifact-identity binding, candidate ordinal ordering, unique property paths, grammar identity and mandatory field presence. Do not silently introduce representation-content validation that conflicts with D0343's regeneration-from-property-path rule.
findings.risk: A positive-only synthetic case is insufficient to establish all intended attestation invariants.

findings.evidence: D0345 requires its effective commit to be the direct parent of the implementation-freeze commit. D0346 is already effective, so a later correction commit will not automatically satisfy that frozen direct-parent relationship.
findings.proposed_correction: Design and independently approve a prospective successor authorization/amendment defining the corrected implementation lineage, preserving historical D0345/D0346 artifacts and both unconsumed one-shot capacities.
findings.risk: A corrected successor implementation cannot reuse D0345 effectiveness assumptions without an explicitly reviewed governance transition.

findings.evidence: The existing non-consuming preflight receipt binds the effective D0346 commit and its exact implementation SHA-256.
findings.proposed_correction: Keep the existing receipt immutable. Under a future separately authorized successor freeze, produce and independently review a new non-consuming implementation-specific preflight receipt; never rewrite or relabel the old one.
